description: SIMULATED CUSTOMER (FICTIONAL): synthetic-customer W6. The MX run driven by ces-tester on the stacksim scenario s2-eng (S2, a fictional 29-person engineering services firm on GCC High G5 with hybrid identity: 26 staff synchronised from on-premises AD by Entra Connect with password hash sync; admin, break-glass, contractor and service accounts cloud-only; 3 enforcing Conditional Access policies (MFA all users, legacy-auth block, admin MFA without a phishing-resistant strength; no session, location or device policy); Intune baseline and BitLocker; personal Android phones under app protection; 2 DLP policies; Defender XDR without Sentinel; an Azure Government landing zone with no key vault and no action group; PLAN.md section 2.1, scoped by the W6 brief). Every organisation, person, id and address is invented. Steps as s1-mach-e2e.json. expected_facts copy S1's five RR-ACT answers: the reads their predicates judge (authentication methods, the Windows compliance policies, Secure Score, the anti-malware list) are seeded identically on S2. expected_state keeps the settings Stamper writes on any tenant and verifies S2's own all-users MFA policy as the remote-maintenance equivalent (no CES policy created). expected_ledger: Stamper creates CMMC-SessionTimeout (S2 has no session policy) and CMMC-AdminMFA-PhishingResistant (S2-CA03 grants plain MFA, so the admin-MFA lookup finds no phishing-resistant equivalent); E7A disables the cloud-only contractor leaver (user-28). E7A runs A-11 (stale-account read), A-02 (offboarding of that leaver, T2, confirming read) and A-09 (PIM role review read); W7-TST: E7A also runs A-21 (leaver lifecycle workflow scheduling, T2; resources.leaver_workflow_id discovered at E5, 52520000-001f-4000-8000-000000000003) and B-09 (BYOD separation, T2; resources.android_app_protection_policy_id and resources.ios_app_protection_policy_id discovered at E5 from the two app-protection lists; its confirming read is the Android policy's dataBackupBlocked, and the iOS write is checked through expected_ledger.mutated). A-11, A-02 and A-09 move nothing (as on S1); expected_improvements is exactly PS.L2-3.9.2 not_met -> met (A-21; V47, V65). B-09 maps to AC.L1-3.1.20, which is not in expected_improvements (no status move predicted, PLAN section 4: B-09 adds two ledger rows). ao_coverage.expected_total is 96 (the ces-ao registry gained A-21). scorecard_gate is off (report-only) until S2's thresholds hold (PLAN section 1, S2 column: SC-3a >= 65 %, SC-8a <= 20 %).

checks.description: Teams external federation access disabled on the Global policy (the base seed has it enabled)
Remote-maintenance MFA: S2's own all-users MFA policy is verified as the equivalent (lookup; no CES policy created)

adminops_ops.description: Stale account detection (read). AO binds operatorUPN and breakGlassUPN from resources.operator_upn and resources.breakglass_upn (copied from the TM at E5).

User offboarding (disable) of the cloud-only contractor leaver whose account is still enabled: resources.offboard_upn, discovered at E5 from the sim (employeeLeaveDateTime passed, accountEnabled true). The leaver is cloud-only on purpose: a synchronised account's accountEnabled is mastered in on-premises AD and could not be changed from the cloud on a real hybrid tenant.

confirm.description: AdminOps A-02: the leaver's account is disabled

adminops_ops.description: Privileged role review (PIM eligibility schedules for the Global, Privileged Role and Security Administrator roles). AO binds the role ids from resources.global_admin_role_def_id, else the built-in template ids.

W7-TST: leaver lifecycle workflow scheduling (PS.L2-3.9.2). resources.leaver_workflow_id is discovered at E5 from the sim: the enabled leaver workflow with a disable/delete-user-account task (S2 Leaver - disable account and remove access, 52520000-001f-4000-8000-000000000003, on demand in the seed). AO turns its scheduling on (the mover is already scheduled: no change); the op fails unless the bound id is such a leaver.

confirm.description: AdminOps A-21: the leaver workflow is scheduled

adminops_ops.description: W7-TST: BYOD separation (MAM): blocks backup, save-as and org-data transfer on S2's Android and iOS app-protection policies. Both ids are AO-sourced (androidAppProtectionPolicyId / iosAppProtectionPolicyId -> resources.android_app_protection_policy_id / resources.ios_app_protection_policy_id); they are listed here so E5 discovers them (the customer, non-CMMC- policy of each list) and AO receives the same values the record holds.

confirm.description: AdminOps B-09: the Android app-protection policy blocks backup

postcheck_thresholds._note: PH-6 R-REG (LOG-PH6-REG.md section 4): honest presence_max 5 for the Azure entries. Earlier: S2 uses the V55 defaults (PLAN section 5 W3): a prediction until the first run; re-baselined by the founder after it.
